verdict.rationale: Relay's docs say it can issue virtual Visa debit cards to a team and set spend limits on cards, which covers creating virtual cards with some controls. Nothing shows cards can be locked to a merchant, vendor or spending category such as ad spend, or that they are available instantly. Missing for 10: per-merchant/vendor or category scoping of virtual cards, evidence of instant virtual card creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor

citations.quote: Issue 50 virtual or physical Visa debit cards to your team
Issue Visa® debit³ or credit cards⁴, set spend limits, define roles, and track every transaction in real time.
